summary_1line: Krishna explains destiny and effort, plans a final peace mission, while Arjuna doubts Duryodhana’s reason yet leaves the decision between peace and war to Krishna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna speaks calmly to Bhima and Arjuna about destiny and effort as the Pandava heroes sit in a tense war council.
Krishna declares he will serve as Arjuna’s charioteer in the coming war while the warriors listen with solemn determination.
Arjuna, angered yet composed, recalls Draupadi’s humiliation in the royal assembly while addressing Krishna.
